assessment.reason: New batch suite checks empty/contiguous sequence/mixed mapping/action index/single append/duplicate cases. Current append_runtime_event_batch maps every event into one storage batch then commits, with checked sequence offsets. Historical optional-field test incorrectly expects WaitResolved to become RetryScheduledEvent; current mapping and regression explicitly require WaitResolvedEvent. Successful all-visible reads cannot prove atomicity across a crash, and duplicate is at first event (not a later conflict after staged prefix). Single-event parity test never calls the single-append comparison path. Preserve meaningful mixed batch rollback/index/strict durability qualification, not those overstated or wrong oracles.

assessment.reason: Historical stress generates one operation per op_index, stores Register handle in handles[op_index], and Drop consults that same once-visited slot. Thus worker Drop sees None; actual successful drops occur only after joins in drain_handles, not interleaved with registration. Sequential stale-handle property does check old-versus-new epochs, but its seed does not create concurrency. Fixed full16 barrier can strand already-spawned threads if a later spawn fails. Current registry has checked epochs and epoch-aware shared handles; these historical tests do not qualify live drop/register races. Row60 additionally blankets lint allowances, not adopted.

assessment.reason: Gate and fixture compatibility: Reject added blanket lint exemptions and hardcoded /tmp artifact paths. Historical Runtime::new return-shape, unchecked old WorkflowParts fields and renamed private test modules are not independent behavior. Current fallible constructors and persistent configured scratch remain authoritative; retained behavioral assertions are disposed separately. AnswerAsk wire slot field rejected; ticket authority retained: Literal answer_slot:SlotIdx replaces ticket:u64 and shrinks max-u64 selector roundtrip to u16 slot boundaries. Current payload still carries ticket; server resolves step0..65535 or checked slot-offset65536..131071 to a unique actual pending AskTicket. Preserve current layout and actual issued ticket/run_attempt/fencing authority; no direct slot field or fabricated ticket is adopted. Bounded-read refusal before cursor consumption: Added cases cover limits1/256/65536, zero/equal/one-below/one-above, u32MAX declaration, exact PayloadTooLarge{actual,limit}, unchanged reader position on refusal, exact accepted bytes and PayloadDecodeFailed for truncated accepted-length data. Current read_frame_payload_bounded checks validate_frame_bounds before allocation/read. Preserve these concrete error/nonmutation assertions through valid flags and typed MaxPayloadBytes. A returned Vec.len assertion alone does not measure allocation capacity or prove allocator bounds. Exact command/payload/response and numeric conversion properties: Old/new assertions retain concrete full typed payload identity, header fields, strict-greater-than payload bounds and u32->usize results. Historical whole-root tests now live in tests_ipc_basic/errors_frames/proptests; function map binds actual bodies and exact assertions, not filenames. Keep those oracles with current command inventory including18, current typed completion ticket authority and valid flags; u32MAX success is target-width dependent and must not erase PayloadLengthOutOfRange on narrower targets. Invalid sender-drop rewrite rejected: Authored disconnected test constructs receiver_only as a complete MemoryIngress, drops only producer(), then expects Disconnected. The struct retains its internal sender, so an empty queue correctly returns Ok(None). Current receiver-only crossbeam fixture drops both original queue and final cloned sender before asserting disconnection; preserve that real producer lifecycle.

assessment.reason: Gate and fixture compatibility: Reject added blanket lint exemptions and hardcoded /tmp artifact paths. Historical Runtime::new return-shape, unchecked old WorkflowParts fields and renamed private test modules are not independent behavior. Current fallible constructors and persistent configured scratch remain authoritative; retained behavioral assertions are disposed separately. Legacy capability envelope rejected specifically: Authored tests repurpose header bytes10..12 into a caller capability bitmap: zero=>PermissionDenied, nonzero=>accepted/preserved ROOT or arbitrary bits, sometimes before payload bounds. Current v1 header encodes zero in those reserved bytes and rejects any nonzero with ReservedNonZero; no caller-auth capability word exists. Reject exactly those bitmap/sentinel/precedence expectations without adding auth, ABI fields or permission behavior. Bounded-read refusal before cursor consumption: Added cases cover limits1/256/65536, zero/equal/one-below/one-above, u32MAX declaration, exact PayloadTooLarge{actual,limit}, unchanged reader position on refusal, exact accepted bytes and PayloadDecodeFailed for truncated accepted-length data. Current read_frame_payload_bounded checks validate_frame_bounds before allocation/read. Preserve these concrete error/nonmutation assertions through valid flags and typed MaxPayloadBytes. A returned Vec.len assertion alone does not measure allocation capacity or prove allocator bounds. Current from_u16 preserves unsupported raw IDs in UnknownCommand and dispatch returns UnsupportedCommand; header acceptance is not runtime command acceptance. assessment.reason: Gate and fixture compatibility: Reject added blanket lint exemptions and hardcoded /tmp artifact paths. Historical Runtime::new return-shape, unchecked old WorkflowParts fields and renamed private test modules are not independent behavior. Current fallible constructors and persistent configured scratch remain authoritative; retained behavioral assertions are disposed separately. Legacy capability envelope rejected specifically: Authored tests repurpose header bytes10..12 into a caller capability bitmap: zero=>PermissionDenied, nonzero=>accepted/preserved ROOT or arbitrary bits, sometimes before payload bounds. Current v1 header encodes zero in those reserved bytes and rejects any nonzero with ReservedNonZero; no caller-auth capability word exists. Reject exactly those bitmap/sentinel/precedence expectations without adding auth, ABI fields or permission behavior. Bounded-read refusal before cursor consumption: Added cases cover limits1/256/65536, zero/equal/one-below/one-above, u32MAX declaration, exact PayloadTooLarge{actual,limit}, unchanged reader position on refusal, exact accepted bytes and PayloadDecodeFailed for truncated accepted-length data. Current read_frame_payload_bounded checks validate_frame_bounds before allocation/read. Preserve these concrete error/nonmutation assertions through valid flags and typed MaxPayloadBytes. A returned Vec.len assertion alone does not measure allocation capacity or prove allocator bounds. Unknown header command preservation: Historical helper names say rejected but body changes accept UnknownCommand for0/65535/unrecognized IDs. Current from_u16 preserves unsupported raw IDs in UnknownCommand and dispatch returns UnsupportedCommand; header acceptance is not runtime command acceptance. Keep exact field/correlation/payload/flag and dispatch-refusal oracle separation through real decoder. Per-command flag validity and exact framing assertions: Positive encode/decode fixtures using arbitrary/all flags, Health0x55AA or flags0xFFFF conflict with CommandFlags reserved-global0xFF00 and per-command valid masks. Keep exact magic/version/command/correlation/length/byte roundtrip and rejection-field intents using a valid command/flag pair; invalid flags need the actual ReservedBitsSet/InvalidCommandFlags result, not weakened validation.

assessment.reason: Gate and fixture compatibility: Reject added blanket lint exemptions and hardcoded /tmp artifact paths. Historical Runtime::new return-shape, unchecked old WorkflowParts fields and renamed private test modules are not independent behavior. Current fallible constructors and persistent configured scratch remain authoritative; retained behavioral assertions are disposed separately. AnswerAsk wire slot field rejected; ticket authority retained: Literal answer_slot:SlotIdx replaces ticket:u64 and shrinks max-u64 selector roundtrip to u16 slot boundaries. Current payload still carries ticket; server resolves step0..65535 or checked slot-offset65536..131071 to a unique actual pending AskTicket. Preserve current layout and actual issued ticket/run_attempt/fencing authority; no direct slot field or fabricated ticket is adopted. Bounded-read refusal before cursor consumption: Added cases cover limits1/256/65536, zero/equal/one-below/one-above, u32MAX declaration, exact PayloadTooLarge{actual,limit}, unchanged reader position on refusal, exact accepted bytes and PayloadDecodeFailed for truncated accepted-length data. Current read_frame_payload_bounded checks validate_frame_bounds before allocation/read. Preserve these concrete error/nonmutation assertions through valid flags and typed MaxPayloadBytes. A returned Vec.len assertion alone does not measure allocation capacity or prove allocator bounds. Exact command/payload/response and numeric conversion properties: Old/new assertions retain concrete full typed payload identity, header fields, strict-greater-than payload bounds and u32->usize results. Historical whole-root tests now live in tests_ipc_basic/errors_frames/proptests; function map binds actual bodies and exact assertions, not filenames. Keep those oracles with current command inventory including18, current typed completion ticket authority and valid flags; u32MAX success is target-width dependent and must not erase PayloadLengthOutOfRange on narrower targets. Invalid sender-drop rewrite rejected: Authored disconnected test constructs receiver_only as a complete MemoryIngress, drops only producer(), then expects Disconnected. The struct retains its internal sender, so an empty queue correctly returns Ok(None). Current receiver-only crossbeam fixture drops both original queue and final cloned sender before asserting disconnection; preserve that real producer lifecycle. Legacy capability envelope rejected specifically: Authored tests repurpose header bytes10..12 into a caller capability bitmap: zero=>PermissionDenied, nonzero=>accepted/preserved ROOT or arbitrary bits, sometimes before payload bounds. Current v1 header encodes zero in those reserved bytes and rejects any nonzero with ReservedNonZero; no caller-auth capability word exists. Reject exactly those bitmap/sentinel/precedence expectations without adding auth, ABI fields or permission behavior. Per-command flag validity and exact framing assertions: Positive encode/decode fixtures using arbitrary/all flags, Health0x55AA or flags0xFFFF conflict with CommandFlags reserved-global0xFF00 and per-command valid masks. Keep exact magic/version/command/correlation/length/byte roundtrip and rejection-field intents using a valid command/flag pair; invalid flags need the actual ReservedBitsSet/InvalidCommandFlags result, not weakened validation.

assessment.reason: Gate and fixture compatibility: Reject added blanket lint exemptions and hardcoded /tmp artifact paths. Historical Runtime::new return-shape, unchecked old WorkflowParts fields and renamed private test modules are not independent behavior. Current fallible constructors and persistent configured scratch remain authoritative; retained behavioral assertions are disposed separately. AnswerAsk wire slot field rejected; ticket authority retained: Literal answer_slot:SlotIdx replaces ticket:u64 and shrinks max-u64 selector roundtrip to u16 slot boundaries. Current payload still carries ticket; server resolves step0..65535 or checked slot-offset65536..131071 to a unique actual pending AskTicket. Preserve current layout and actual issued ticket/run_attempt/fencing authority; no direct slot field or fabricated ticket is adopted. Real pending Ask success, refusal and consumability: Historical fixtures demand exact default-clean I64(42) journal bytes, wrong-slot refusal followed by valid I64(8), absent pending ask, and malformed Postcard bytes followed by valid Bool(false), observing completion/journal. Keep those intent-specific state/nonmutation/output assertions with real accepted workflow, current payload ticket offset and actual pending AskTicket. Current missing/mismatched selector returns BadRequest before enqueue, not old InvalidActionCompletion/RunNotFound RuntimeError; malformed content still decodes before ticket resolution. Preserve real current ordering and full before/after ticket/queue/journal controls. Cancel reason wire schema proposal rejected: Literal CancelRun{run_id,reason} is not current payload: v1 carries run_id only; current handler queues Runtime::cancel_run with reasonNone. ReasonSome(empty)/Some(text) payload and matching persisted string expectations need an explicitly accepted schema/API requirement and are not restored by test reconciliation. This does not assert current cancellation lost an accepted caller field. Cancellation refusal/idempotence and journal effect custody: Keep meaningful one terminal journal transition, omitted-reasonNone, repeat-cancel no duplicate effect and actual cancellation routing through valid admitted current run. Row35 explicitly adds empty-string distinction and terminal typed-noop; the former belongs to rejected optional field, while nonmutation/idempotence goal remains qualified through accepted current API/error semantics.

assessment.reason: Gate and fixture compatibility: Reject added blanket lint exemptions and hardcoded /tmp artifact paths. Historical Runtime::new return-shape, unchecked old WorkflowParts fields and renamed private test modules are not independent behavior. Current fallible constructors and persistent configured scratch remain authoritative; retained behavioral assertions are disposed separately. Legacy capability envelope rejected specifically: Authored tests repurpose header bytes10..12 into a caller capability bitmap: zero=>PermissionDenied, nonzero=>accepted/preserved ROOT or arbitrary bits, sometimes before payload bounds. Current v1 header encodes zero in those reserved bytes and rejects any nonzero with ReservedNonZero; no caller-auth capability word exists. Reject exactly those bitmap/sentinel/precedence expectations without adding auth, ABI fields or permission behavior. Bounded-read refusal before cursor consumption: Added cases cover limits1/256/65536, zero/equal/one-below/one-above, u32MAX declaration, exact PayloadTooLarge{actual,limit}, unchanged reader position on refusal, exact accepted bytes and PayloadDecodeFailed for truncated accepted-length data. Current read_frame_payload_bounded checks validate_frame_bounds before allocation/read. Preserve these concrete error/nonmutation assertions through valid flags and typed MaxPayloadBytes. A returned Vec.len assertion alone does not measure allocation capacity or prove allocator bounds. Unknown header command preservation: Historical helper names say rejected but body changes accept UnknownCommand for0/65535/unrecognized IDs. Current from_u16 preserves unsupported raw IDs in UnknownCommand and dispatch returns UnsupportedCommand; header acceptance is not runtime command acceptance. Keep exact field/correlation/payload/flag and dispatch-refusal oracle separation through real decoder. Per-command flag validity and exact framing assertions: Positive encode/decode fixtures using arbitrary/all flags, Health0x55AA or flags0xFFFF conflict with CommandFlags reserved-global0xFF00 and per-command valid masks. Keep exact magic/version/command/correlation/length/byte roundtrip and rejection-field intents using a valid command/flag pair; invalid flags need the actual ReservedBitsSet/InvalidCommandFlags result, not weakened validation.

assessment.reason: Gate and fixture compatibility: Reject added blanket lint exemptions and hardcoded /tmp artifact paths. Historical Runtime::new return-shape, unchecked old WorkflowParts fields and renamed private test modules are not independent behavior. Current fallible constructors and persistent configured scratch remain authoritative; retained behavioral assertions are disposed separately. AnswerAsk wire slot field rejected; ticket authority retained: Literal answer_slot:SlotIdx replaces ticket:u64 and shrinks max-u64 selector roundtrip to u16 slot boundaries. Current payload still carries ticket; server resolves step0..65535 or checked slot-offset65536..131071 to a unique actual pending AskTicket. Preserve current layout and actual issued ticket/run_attempt/fencing authority; no direct slot field or fabricated ticket is adopted. Bounded-read refusal before cursor consumption: Added cases cover limits1/256/65536, zero/equal/one-below/one-above, u32MAX declaration, exact PayloadTooLarge{actual,limit}, unchanged reader position on refusal, exact accepted bytes and PayloadDecodeFailed for truncated accepted-length data. Current read_frame_payload_bounded checks validate_frame_bounds before allocation/read. Preserve these concrete error/nonmutation assertions through valid flags and typed MaxPayloadBytes. A returned Vec.len assertion alone does not measure allocation capacity or prove allocator bounds. Exact command/payload/response and numeric conversion properties: Old/new assertions retain concrete full typed payload identity, header fields, strict-greater-than payload bounds and u32->usize results. Historical whole-root tests now live in tests_ipc_basic/errors_frames/proptests; function map binds actual bodies and exact assertions, not filenames. Keep those oracles with current command inventory including18, current typed completion ticket authority and valid flags; u32MAX success is target-width dependent and must not erase PayloadLengthOutOfRange on narrower targets. Invalid sender-drop rewrite rejected: Authored disconnected test constructs receiver_only as a complete MemoryIngress, drops only producer(), then expects Disconnected. The struct retains its internal sender, so an empty queue correctly returns Ok(None). Current receiver-only crossbeam fixture drops both original queue and final cloned sender before asserting disconnection; preserve that real producer lifecycle. Legacy capability envelope rejected specifically: Authored tests repurpose header bytes10..12 into a caller capability bitmap: zero=>PermissionDenied, nonzero=>accepted/preserved ROOT or arbitrary bits, sometimes before payload bounds. Current v1 header encodes zero in those reserved bytes and rejects any nonzero with ReservedNonZero; no caller-auth capability word exists. Reject exactly those bitmap/sentinel/precedence expectations without adding auth, ABI fields or permission behavior. Per-command flag validity and exact framing assertions: Positive encode/decode fixtures using arbitrary/all flags, Health0x55AA or flags0xFFFF conflict with CommandFlags reserved-global0xFF00 and per-command valid masks. Keep exact magic/version/command/correlation/length/byte roundtrip and rejection-field intents using a valid command/flag pair; invalid flags need the actual ReservedBitsSet/InvalidCommandFlags result, not weakened validation.

assessment.reason: New batch suite checks empty/contiguous sequence/mixed mapping/action index/single append/duplicate cases. Current append_runtime_event_batch maps every event into one storage batch then commits, with checked sequence offsets. Historical optional-field test incorrectly expects WaitResolved to become RetryScheduledEvent; current mapping and regression explicitly require WaitResolvedEvent. Successful all-visible reads cannot prove atomicity across a crash, and duplicate is at first event (not a later conflict after staged prefix). Single-event parity test never calls the single-append comparison path. Preserve meaningful mixed batch rollback/index/strict durability qualification, not those overstated or wrong oracles. Additional exact-tuple delta: Adds MAX sequence two/three-event overflow tests, expected typed SequenceOverflow and zero committed events in first case; default impl tested via Noop whose default multi-event batch now fails closed UnsupportedOperation before overflow. Frozen storage adapter builds one batch with checked per-offset sequence before commit. In-range tests use presence without full decoded payload/unique index checks. Preserve actual storage/default port semantics and sequence failure nonmutation.

assessment.reason: Historical stress generates one operation per op_index, stores Register handle in handles[op_index], and Drop consults that same once-visited slot. Thus worker Drop sees None; actual successful drops occur only after joins in drain_handles, not interleaved with registration. Sequential stale-handle property does check old-versus-new epochs, but its seed does not create concurrency. Fixed full16 barrier can strand already-spawned threads if a later spawn fails. Current registry has checked epochs and epoch-aware shared handles; these historical tests do not qualify live drop/register races. Row60 additionally blankets lint allowances, not adopted. Additional exact-tuple delta: Property failure macros become panic, preserving failure outcomes; one detailed first-overlap failure diagnostic becomes placeholder. Worker live-handle indexing defect persists, so no new actual drop/register race coverage.

pending_intents.intent: Qualify live overlapping register/replace/drop interleavings on current introspection registry, stale-handle isolation and final visibility using reusable live handle slots and bounded spawn-failure handling; sequential stale-drop checks do not qualify the race.
